menu
An alpaca piece stands out as especially thoughtful and unique. Sourced directly from small herding communities in the Andes, the natural fiber is naturally hypoallergenic, incredibly soft, and warmer than standard wool.
Because the colors come straight from the undyed fleece, an alpaca beanie or scarf feels deeply authentic and special while remaining versatile enough for everyday wear.
